brief: A seven-cell honeycomb standing on at least three stud spikes facing down as feet.

requirements.evidence: 7 full pieces at 0,0,0 centre with 6 neighbours forming honeycomb: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:-1,1,0;full, piece:0,-1,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,-1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full

requirements.requirement: Standing on at least three stud spikes facing down as feet
requirements.evidence: 3 stud spikes facing down: spike:0#-1,0|-1,1|0,0, spike:0#0,-1|0,0|1,-1, spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 all added with variant stud facing down

finish.summary: Built central cell with 6 neighbours (7-cell honeycomb) and added 3 stud spikes facing down as feet at three of the six internal junctions. House rules applied (caps and joint bolts).

lines.label: M6 brass heat-set insert, 7.6 mm (initeq M6-1.0 Short)
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
